g.text: ONE BRAKE BRANCH / EXTERNAL RESISTOR / CONTROLLER HEADER COMMAND

g.desc: ONE BRAKE BRANCH / EXTERNAL RESISTOR / CONTROLLER HEADER COMMAND

g.text: D2 is DNP. The input diode / TVS / fuse are still procurement and energy/thermal review items.

g.desc: D2 is DNP. The input diode / TVS / fuse are still procurement and energy/thermal review items.

g.text: No main-bus precharge or dedicated bleeder. U/V/W are raw bridge PWM, not LC-filtered sine outputs.

g.desc: No main-bus precharge or dedicated bleeder. U/V/W are raw bridge PWM, not LC-filtered sine outputs.

g.text: J5: BR+ = VBUS, BR_SW = MOS drain. External resistor goes across these pins; unused port stays OPEN.

g.desc: J5: BR+ = VBUS, BR_SW = MOS drain. External resistor goes across these pins; unused port stays OPEN.

g.text: Brake is independent of the bridge ENABLE/fault gates. The base-side input pull-down defaults a missing controller command LOW.

g.desc: Brake is independent of the bridge ENABLE/fault gates. The base-side input pull-down defaults a missing controller command LOW.

g.text: MAIN BUS INPUT / BULK CAPACITORS / RAW PWM OUTPUTS
